Integrate LIF signal over depth per boring (RE-feet)

Source: R/process.R
re_feet.Rd

The trapezoidal integral of signal against depth for each boring, a single number summarising how much fluorescence a boring encountered. Like %RE itself it is a screening quantity, not a mass or concentration.

Usage

re_feet(data)

Arguments

data

A lif_data frame.

Value

One row per boring with boring, re_feet, peak_signal, peak_depth, and the boring's easting, northing, msl when present.

Examples

demo <- system.file("extdata", "demo", package = "lifr")
lif <- lif_import(demo, verbose = FALSE)
re_feet(lif)
